name: Elune's Grace
label: Quest
description: Elune's Grace: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Time's a wastin', friend. It's time for you to return home to Darnassus. Priestess Alathea's sent word here that you're to return there for training. Seems they feel you're ready to be tested much like those who serve the Light. You should head out whenever you can. Alathea's message said that she'd be waitin' for you in the Temple of the Moon. Good luck.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Elune bless you for returning so quickly to us. This is an important time in your training, and a time that all of our order take very seriously. When you've rested from your journey here, please, let me know. We can then discuss the continuation of your training and where your path will lead you next.
